section: Summary of Benefits for the Standard Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. - 2026

rows.You pay: 50% up to Plan allowance for diagnostic and preventive services and charges in excess of the scheduled amounts for restorations and extractions

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Protection against catastrophic costs (your catastrophic protection out-of-pocket maximum):
rows.You pay: In-network - Self Only $6,500 ($13,000 Self Plus One or Self and Family) per year Out-of-network - Self Only $8,500 ($17,000 Self Plus One or Self and Family) per year
